products: quarter, half and whole beef shares

feeding_claim.verbatim: Yes! Our cattle are 100% grass-fed and grass-finished, meaning they graze on open pastures their entire lives.

notes: Red Angus herd on a family farm near Carroll in west-central Iowa. Read homepage, our story, FAQ and contact pages (WebFetch summaries only, so the Verifier should recheck the verbatim quote from the FAQ). Story page describes rotational grazing on perennial grass and legume pastures with baled grass and minerals in winter, no feedlot; FAQ says no GMO grains, not explicitly no grain at all, but grass-finished language is explicit. FAQ lists 28 standard shipping states and says other continental states can be coordinated, so ships-regional. Farm pickup by appointment for retail cuts; quarter, half and whole shares picked up at the processor, which is not named. Owners not named on the site; contact page gives Carroll, IA 51401 without a street address. No phone published. Not checked whether all cattle are born on the farm.
